verdicts.reason: Both lose the white panel and turn the full-bleed grey/blue/red stripes into thin, detached bars. All the copy shrinks to an unreadable few pixels ($49.99 is the only legible line) and floats on blank white with a big dead gap between it and the stripes. A pushes the text block to the far right edge, leaving an empty left margin and middle. B parks the stripes at the left edge and centres the text, leaving the right third dead, and its letter spacing breaks down ('COFFEEMUGS', 'TRAVELMUGS'). A is marginally less broken.
